source: Existing result_row.token_logprobs; per-token loss is its negative.

continuation.slice: token_logprobs[1:] for answers with at least two tokens

estimands: mean of per-question mean token losses within each group
all-token weighted mean loss within each group

bootstrap.sampling: sample ten conversation IDs with replacement, retain every selected question and its multiplicity; use the same draws across conditions and groups

interpretation: Native CPU address audit separately determines whether the first prediction position directly reads written Delta rows.
A first-token difference may support an indirect influence through the question prefix if direct Delta reads are zero; token losses alone do not identify the information source causally.
Continuation targets are teacher-forced and can include different n-gram addresses; improvements do not establish successful free-generation recall.
Report all conditions and contrasts for both groups, including null or adverse effects.
